$comment: Decision cases for every pure function in scripts/port-forensics/classify.ts (#123), run by scripts/checks/forensics.ts — the six assertions, the two reimplemented shell-syntax predicates, and item correlation. Includes a case for each stated fail direction: an 'unknown' termination, a 'not-computable' notification result, and the shell-loop/timeout/denial positive and negative shapes.
